verdict.rationale: Superset documents an official TypeScript SDK for creating and managing workspaces, tasks, projects, and automations from code, with bulk task scripting as a stated use case. A probe found a live OpenAPI 3.1 spec that the SDK fronts. Evidence covers only one language and only getting-started-level docs. missing for 10: SDKs in languages beyond TypeScript, in-depth SDK reference documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The Superset TypeScript SDK lets you create and manage your workspaces, tasks, projects, and automations from code.
Bulk task management: script the creation, triage, or cleanup of tasks across one or many projects.
